summary: Interactive quality command selected a headless CLI Agent instead of a visible child Agent

expected.behavior: Use the host lifecycle Coordinator to create and observe a visible child Agent for an interactive command.

actual.behavior: The quality Run launched a process-backed CLI Agent.

steps: Run h:engine quality V3.8.4 in an interactive Codex task.
Inspect the resolved lifecycle plan and Run runtime policy.
Observe that the Run uses headless mode and codex-cli-runtime rather than a visible child Agent.

excerpts.text: 为什么质量 Run 会运行后台CLI？不是应该开子Agent吗？

The recorded quality policy selected headless mode with codex-cli-runtime and userVisible false, so the Harness launched a process-backed CLI Agent instead of a visible child Agent. For an interactive task, the expected mode is conversation-visible.
